audiences.name: Collectors
audiences.pain: You want the card, but you do not want enthusiasm to hide weak evidence.
audiences.value: FlipForge separates the exact-card facts from the story and shows what still needs verification.
audiences.cta: Inspect the decision before you buy.

audiences.name: Investors
audiences.pain: A chart can show what happened without telling you whether today’s opportunity is defensible.
audiences.value: FlipForge connects identity, evidence, economics, risk, and outcome tracking into one decision record.
audiences.cta: See the reasoning, not just the trend.

audiences.name: Flippers
audiences.pain: An apparent spread disappears fast when comps are wrong, liquidity is weak, or costs are ignored.
audiences.value: FlipForge pressure-tests the spread before you commit capital.
audiences.cta: Test the margin before you chase it.

audiences.name: Dealers
audiences.pain: Inventory decisions compound quickly when a weak comp or identity mismatch slips through.
audiences.value: FlipForge creates a repeatable decision process your inventory review can trace later.
audiences.cta: Make inventory decisions you can explain.

audiences.name: Grading users
audiences.pain: Population and grade spread matter, but they do not answer the whole purchase decision.
audiences.value: FlipForge keeps grading intelligence in context with evidence, economics, and uncertainty.
audiences.cta: Use grade context without losing the full decision.
